responsibility: Shared miscellaneous exception-support routines independent of the underlying unwinding mechanism. Its main responsibility is the default unhandled-exception termination path, which exits the process after Ada-side reporting/finalization, and for non-runtime builds it also provides a stub __gnat_backtrace symbol so compiler-side code can link without the real traceback implementation.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file in the raise pair: it provides executable exception-support code, notably the default __gnat_unhandled_terminate path that exits via __gnat_os_exit, and in non-runtime builds a stub __gnat_backtrace for linking. Unlike gcc/ada/raise.h, it supplies concrete termination/linkage behavior instead of defining exception data structures and declaring runtime hooks.
